brief: Two bins to sort my dead AA batteries for recycling.

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full: two full-depth open bins side by side on joined bases piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full. check_build clear. No AA-battery prop exists in find_props (battery search 0 results), so bins left empty for user batteries.
requirements.requirement: Two bins to sort dead AA batteries for recycling

finish.summary: Two-cell joined base with two full-depth open bins for sorting dead AA batteries. Verified clear, capped and locked. No battery props exist so bins are empty and ready to fill.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Two battery sort bins — I'll build them.
